newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Electric wins TEPCO geothermal plant tender.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Electric wins TEPCO geothermal plant tender.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc (TEPCO) said on Friday that electric machinery maker Fuji Electric Co Ltd had won negotiating rights in a project to build a geothermal power plant for the power firm.
"Fuji Electric outbid three other competitors in a recent tender," a TEPCO spokesman said.
The electric utility plans to build a 3,300-kilowatt (kw) geothermal power station on Hachijojima island, 300 km south of Tokyo, by 1999.
TEPCO will pass an order for the project, worth roughly 5.8 billion yen, to Fuji Electric if both sides reach an agreement on the details of the project, such as the design of the generator, he said.
Currently, TEPCO is covering the power needs of the island, which has a population of some 9,500, with a gas oil-powered, 11,100-kw generator.
Fuji Electric officials were not immediately available for comment due to a summer holiday at the company.
